Died

Woodlands Cemetery, Granville, Massachusetts

Born in colonial Connecticut and died in Granville, Massachusetts. Military registration is reported, but wartime service remains unconfirmed.

Jesse married Ruth Miller about 1786 in Ridgefield, Connecticut. Their family included nine children. After Ruth’s death, he married Elisabeth Dibble on February 20, 1814, in Granville, Massachusetts. Military registration in 1780 is reported; wartime service remains unconfirmed.
